<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>RBI liquidity management:</strong> The Reserve Bank of India has withdrawn over ₹6 trillion from the banking system following a record liquidity spike, utilizing VRRR auctions to manage surplus funds.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-IN&amp;gl=IN&amp;ceid=IN%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-IN&amp;gl=IN&amp;ceid=IN%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-IN&amp;gl=IN&amp;ceid=IN%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-IN&amp;gl=IN&amp;ceid=IN%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxOWmRWQTdTSHFqX0ZlaU1RMG9MX1I2TlNBVVdLYVpjRVRXS1NjNHM1Vm1IQWJaMWczM3pwNWVmSm9lUTJwUl9JVHJuRVpSbDBHRm1YMU5hbDl3SS1ROEhwRUJDZGFpRWhsM1ZoaXpUS3lnSnhvR2k3NlAyZC1XUkowMTFDVXhEQ1dkcGZMeTAxbGhYdVkwazZMa1QxUzEtemdxMkRJZU03MXU3RGJHYVJhd21DMi1COW4wLXJxUV92Yw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-IN&amp;gl=IN&amp;ceid=IN%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a></span></li>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
